The enhancement literature shows that different methods can perform differently depending on the dataset and metric. Published comparisons report varying PSNR, SSIM and UIQM results for WaterNet, FUnIE-GAN and Shallow-UWnet, so no single method should be assumed to be best before testing it on the project dataset.
